title: fix(transit): handle RFC 5322 folded Message-ID in extract_body_msgid
description: extract_body_msgid in ingestion.rs does not handle RFC 5322 header folding. A folded Message-ID header (value on continuation line starting with SP/HTAB) causes extract_body_msgid to return Some(""), which body_msgid.is_empty() converts to a dedup bypass — the same article can be ingested repeatedly. A malicious peer can use this to force unbounded IPFS writes while satisfying the mandatory-header check. Fix: collect continuation lines in extract_body_msgid.
